text:
maria: Quick sync: enumerating options for internal API layer - delegate-to-proto-adapter vs gateway-translate. need a decision on quotas/telemetry impact.
ben: short version: delegate keeps proto fidelity and schema-level metrics, translate is simpler ops-wise.
alice: telemetry angle: with delegate we can emit field-level usage (e.g., model_id parsed from proto) and avoid heuristics. translate loses typed fields unless we reconstruct them.
sam: performance: delegate adds one network hop. i'd like to see median + p95 delta for us-east colocation. might be tiny if adapters are co-located.
carla: ops: adapters = extra services to run + SLA. we need clear health signals and automatic fallback rules if adapter fails. otherwise a single adapter flake could take routes down.
maria: quota placement question: do we enforce per-tenant rate limits at the gateway or adapter? proposal: gateway enforces coarse ingress quotas, adapter enforces fine-grained quotas (tokens/model/feature flags) and emits usage events to metering.
ben: agree. gateway should do quick rejects for abusive bursts (cheap local checks). adapter owns billable counters to avoid double-counting. both should stamp the same request id.
alice: required headers: `x-rw-tenant`, `x-rw-req-id`, `x-rw-route`, `x-rw-model` (optional). adapter + metering consume them.
infra: For reconciliation, use a 500ms window where adapter reports usage. gateway keeps a small token-bucket allowance and reconciles on adapter ack. if adapter later reports overspend, gateway returns 429 on subsequent requests and emits billing audit.
carla: We must document backpressure behavior: gateway circuit-breaker -> short-circuit to translate-mode if route flag `allow_translate` is set, otherwise fail fast. Runbook should include how to flip route toggle via console.
maria: console UX: add per-route toggle (delegate <-> translate), show adapter health, queued bytes, per-route p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec and cost estimate. link traces to adapter spans.
sam: I'll benchmark: co-located delegate vs translate; will vary with payload sizes and streaming. also test cold-starts for adapters.
ben: billing clarity: metering events should be canonical source of truth. adapter emits structured metering JSON: `[tenant, route, model, tokens_in, tokens_out, req_id, trace_id]`. central pipeline aggregates to per-tenant hourly buckets.
alice: telemetry fields we need in the event: `proto_method`, `proto_version`, `response_kind` (cache/hit/fallback), `fallback_reason` if any. Make schema extensible versioned.
ops-bot: alert: adapter-proto-transformer-us-east reported degraded (90s latency spike).
carla: ops action: gateway should have automatic soft-fail policy: when adapter latency > X or failing, flip routes with `allow_translate` on to translate and notify on-call.
maria: decision path proposal for RFC: 1) default to delegate for new proto-first routes 2) gateways enforce ingress quotas + local-burst with reconciliation 3) adapters own billable metering and emit canonical events 4) console toggle + gitops flag to flip delegate/translate per-route 5) fallback to translate when adapter degraded and route allows. any objections?
enough: silence = +1. i'll draft RFC and owners: alice (telemetry schema), sam (perf sims), carla (ops/playbook), ben (gateway token-bucket prototype).
